name: shadchan-functions
description: Server side of the personal card: notifications, Hebrew birthdays, account cleanup.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-shadchan "node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules_test/card_rules.test.mjs rules_test/storage_rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:flows: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-shadchan "node --test rules_test/flows.test.mjs"
scripts.test:workspaces: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions,auth,storage --project demo-shadchan "node --test --test-concurrency=1 rules_test/flows.test.mjs rules_test/workspace_flows.test.mjs"
